The Supreme Commander standing at the pinnacle of the Gotei 13 summons four members to the sauna with strict orders and clever enticements...

Each summoned for different reasons, they become captivated by the Supreme Commander's lewd techniques amidst the heat waves and steam,
offering their sweat-drenched bodies in forbidden special training!

Episode 1: Captain of the 2nd Division (74P)
"Your strength as a captain is lacking."
Summoned to the sauna by the Captain-Commander's harsh criticism.
"I'll make you stronger"—Amidst the heat, intense special training (sex) unfolds, melting the proud captain's body...

Chapter 2: 12th Division Vice-Captain (71P)
"I'd like to borrow your masterpiece."
Borrowing the Vice-Captain from the 12th Division Captain, the Captain takes her to the sauna.
The reason was "to test how much heat she can endure," but...
Her artificial body trembles with sweat and pleasure, surrendering to the Captain's fierce assault!

Episode 3: 4th Division Vice-Captain (70P)
"I want to acknowledge your daily efforts and discuss the future."
Praised by the Captain-General, she heads to the designated location, only to find it's a sauna...
The conversation that began with words of appreciation transforms into a steamy, intense union, and the energetic Vice-Captain's voice turns into gasps.

Episode 4: 4th Squad Captain (70P)
"My body won't recover. May I borrow the steam room?"
Responding to the Commander-in-Chief's request, Unohana heads to the sauna.
As they reminisced, passion reignited in the steam, and even the gentle captain's switch flipped...?
